prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 财务指标 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 154px
  col 2: header "2022 年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 57px
  col 3: header "2023 年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 57px
  col 4: header "2024 年" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 57px
  col 5: header "同比" · longest unbreakable word 54px · one-line width 54px
  col 6: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 276px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示五项财务指标在 2022—2024 年的变化，以及同比结果和备注。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再横向比较三个年度的数值和同比变化；备注提供补充解释。","groups":["第 2—4 列都是年度数值，应保持一致的宽度和对齐方式，方便跨年比较。","第 5 列是变化结果，与年度数值相邻，便于核对趋势。","第 1 列标识指标，第 6 列提供说明，分别承担识别和解释作用。"],"keep_intact":["年度数值及百分比","同比变化数值及其单位或符号","指标名称中的单位","年份表头"],"may_wrap":["指标名称可在自然语义边界换行。","备注中的说明文字可以自然换行；同一行较高时可容纳这些换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [105, 78, 78, 78, 75, 120] · table 535×358px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 83, 83, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 175px
Design r1B: widths [90, 78, 78, 78, 75, 105] · table 505×428px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 106, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 145px
Design r1C: widths [125, 78, 78, 78, 75, 120] · table 555×358px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 83, 83, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 195px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"年度列等宽，表头和数字完整，便于逐行比较；指标列大多能将名称与单位分行，阅读顺序清楚。","problems":"初始视口只显示同比列的一小部分，备注需要横向滚动；经营性现金流一行的指标名称被拆开，较高的行也让数字之间出现较多空白。","cause":"三个年度列各占78px，连同105px的指标列，已占339px；指标列的84px内容宽度又不足以完整容纳较长名称。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"相比r1A，总宽减少30px，年度列仍然等宽，数值和表头保持完整，初始视口能看到稍多的同比列。","problems":"指标名称和单位被切得更碎，资产负债率也换行；多行过高，数字列中的空白削弱了行的连续性，备注仍需横向滚动。","cause":"指标列降至90px，仅有69px内容宽度；备注列降至105px，也增加了说明文字换行，两者共同拉高部分行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"较宽的指标列让经营性现金流的名称保持在一起；年度列整齐，表格高度也与r1A相同。","problems":"营业收入和研发投入的单位被拆行；初始视口几乎只容纳指标和三个年度，同比与备注都需要滚动才能阅读。额外的指标列宽度没有带来更紧凑的整体。","cause":"125px指标列的104px内容宽度恰好使部分名称后的单位落在行尾并被拆开；它比r1A多占20px，进一步挤出同比列。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"均衡比较","widths":[105,66,66,66,75,120],"change":"保留r1A较好的指标和备注宽度，将三个年度列统一缩至66px；每列仍有45px内容宽度，足以容纳所给年度表头与不可拆分数值，并让初始视口显示更多同比信息。"},{"name":"完整同比","widths":[86,66,66,66,75,120],"change":"将指标列压至86px，使指标、三个年度及同比恰好合计359px；备注通过横向滚动查看。以指标名称更多换行为代价，测试首屏完整比较数据的价值。"},{"name":"宽指标紧年度","widths":[145,66,66,66,75,120],"change":"加宽指标列以改善较长名称和单位的连续性，同时收紧等宽年度列；测试更清晰的行标识是否值得增加横向滚动。"}]}
